description: Create a selected paid PrivateDAO capability request and return an immediate result or exact quote-first payment intent. Use discover_agents or list_catalog first; payment_mode=privatepay starts the PrivatePAY flow, while direct uses ordinary USDC. This call never spends funds.

inputSchema.description: Create a selected paid service request and return either an immediate result or an exact quote-first payment intent. This call does not spend funds; use the returned quote with the matching payment tool.

input.description: Service-specific JSON input matching the selected service schema.

payment_mode.description: Select privatepay only when the PrivatePAY x402 status is enabled.

pdao_access.description: Optional signed PDAO holder challenge from /api/access/challenge.

service_id.description: Paid service identifier selected from list_catalog or discover_agents.

name: create_paid_job

outputSchema.description: Quote-first service request result; creating the request does not spend funds.

payment_intent.description: Exact quote and recipient details when payment is required.

receipt.description: Public receipt metadata when the request completes.

result.description: Service result when the request completes immediately.

status.description: Request status, commonly awaiting_payment or completed.

title: PrivateDAO Service Request
